A '''villa''' located on the<ref name="Rebirth" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] was destroyed<ref name="Rebirth" /> sometime before [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The tree appeared in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second volume of the ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'', which was itself a part of the series ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''.<ref name="Rebirth" />
